Satoyama Treasure Hunter!! ~ Make wreaths from nature's materials

Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-morimana-treasurehunter/

An interactive eco-tour where you enjoy treasure hunting in nature while learning about creature ecosystems and the charm of satoyama (foothills and grasslands) together with specialist students.

【Fee】Adults: ¥2,500 | Students: ¥1,500 | Preschool children: ¥1,000 (includes guide, insurance, materials, food)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Mori no Field Gakusha (Forest Field Study Hall) staff

【What to bring】Gloves, drinks, lunch, spare clothes, insect repellent if needed

【Notes】Mori no Field Gakusha website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」下車徒歩3分）
